Title: Service Fabric Version 6.4 CU5 Refresh Release

Body.Content:
The latest refresh release for Service Fabric version 6.4 contains several bug fixes and improvements. See Service Fabric team blog for details.

For future updates, watch the Service Fabric Team blog for detailed release notes when the release is made available.
